fichas.title: Operating department
fichas.summary: Planning guidance for an operating department, covering its location, room requirements, equipment, and separation of clean, dirty, patient, and staff routes. The department should be centrally accessible and near intensive care, recovery, and the central sterile store. Operating theatres should be as uniform and square as possible, with automated doors and a centrally mounted operating table. The page also illustrates an equipment plan and a surgery zone at the Helios Clinic Berlin-Buch.
furniture_equipment: Adjustable, transportable operating table on a fixed central plinth
Dish stands with and without heater
Sockets for anaesthetic equipment and emergency power
